name: UEFA Euro
_comment: Hand-encoded SOURCE data (committed, unlike the regenerable DB). Team names use the matches-table DB spelling; the six groups were reconstructed + verified directly from the DB's Euro-2024 group-stage match graph (Czech Republic / Turkey, NOT Czechia / Turkiye). 24-team 'euro24' format: six groups of four, top-2 of each group PLUS the four best third-placed teams advance to the Round of 16. Bracket 'home'/'away' are venue-neutral labels: '1A'=winner group A, '2B'=runner-up group B, '3vB'/'3vC'/'3vE'/'3vF'=the best-third assigned to face the winner of group B/C/E/F (which group's third fills each is resolved per-simulation from the six thirds via this config's own thirds_table below, UEFA's fixed anti-rematch table for the modern 2020/2024 bracket - note Euro 2016 used a DIFFERENT layout, so the table lives in each config, not as a shared constant). 'W38'=winner of match 38. Match ids 37-51 follow the official Euro-2024 numbering (3rd-place match omitted; there is none). Cross-checkable against https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UEFA_Euro_2024 (Tomas's manual-verification domain). Sanity note: the four thirds that actually qualified were from groups C/D/E/F, and EURO_THIRDS_TABLE['CDEF'] reproduces the real R16 assignments exactly (Spain-Georgia, England-Slovakia, Romania-Netherlands, Portugal-Slovenia).
